articles.title: Yemen market bombing kills 20 as Qatar tries to avert new US-Iran clash
articles.description: AIR strikes killed at least 20 people at a market in south-west Yemen today as the Saudi-led coalition launched new bombing raids.Ansar Allah, as the Houthi movement which swept to power in Yemen in 2014 is formally known, said another 15 people were wounded in the bombing of al-Waziyah market in the province of Taiz.Taiz is a current battleground with the Houthis controlling most of the area and laying siege to the capital, which is still in the hands of the Yemeni government in exile based in Saudi Arabia.
